meta.why: Your team's mix of 2D character animation and design-driven spots is exactly the kind of work I want to be doing.
Your network rebrands are a big reason I moved toward broadcast graphics.

messages.text:
Subject: Motion designer interested in Psyop

Hi Sam,

I'm finishing my MA in Motion Media Design at SCAD this November... (example email)

Thanks,
Zack

Subject: Following up on my Broadcast Designer application

Hi Alex, I applied for the Broadcast Designer role recently and wanted to follow up directly... (example email)

Hi Zack, thanks for following up. We're reviewing reels for the broadcast team over the next two weeks. Could you send a version of your reel that leads with your broadcast work? Happy to set up a call after that.

Alex (example reply)
